name: 0008-rules-folder-floor
description: A change to a rules folder is at least ask, whatever merge rule applies.

rules.repo/rules/spec-verified.md:
---
kind: merge
mode: live
require: [linked_requirement, approved_checks_pass, no_test_edits, gate_green, pipeline_green, ai_review_not_blocking, up_to_date]
max_changed_lines: 600
paths_not: [".gitlab-ci.yml"]
then: proceed
---
Spec work merges on its own when the approved checks prove it.
